description: CDGV Salvador Preliminar - Sistema de Transporte Ferroviário is a dataset listed in Brazilian national spatial data infrastructure metadata catalogue (INDE), a metadata catalogue (CSW), published or maintained by Infraestrutura Nacional de Dados Espaciais (INDE). Segundo a Norma de Especificações Técnicas para Estruturação de Dados Geoespaciais Vetoriais – ET-EDGV Salvador 2017, as classes que fazem parte da categoria Sistema de Transporte Ferroviário da cidade de Salvador são: Estação rodoviária; Trecho rodoviário; Via deslocamento. Coverage: Brasil. Its tags are CDGV, Salvador, Transporte, Ferroviário, imageryBaseMapsEarthCover. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-csw-inde-portal.
